info.title: Steady Universal API
info.description: Use Steady OAuth2 for member-scoped endpoints like /users/me and /subscriptions/me, and use the Steady API key for publication-scoped REST endpoints like /publication, /plans, and /subscriptions.

put.description: Cancels a Steady subscription at the current term's end.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

subscriptionId.description: The Steady subscription ID to cancel.

post.description: Creates a new audio post in Steady.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

content.description: Optional post content. HTML is sanitized by Steady.

distributeAsEmail.description: Optional boolean to send the post as email when published.

distributeOnSteadyPage.description: Optional boolean to display the post on the Steady page.

publishAt.description: Optional future ISO8601 datetime to schedule publication.

publishedAt.description: Optional ISO8601 datetime for an already-published post.

restrictToPlanIds.description: Optional list of plan IDs that can access the post.

teaserImage.description: Optional image URL used when displaying the post on Steady.
